people.name: GUNDERT, Hermann – Persons of Indian Studies by Prof. Dr. Klaus Karttunen

relations.subject: Hermann Gundert
relations.evidence: Studies of theology at Tübingen, theol. examen and Ph.D. 1835 there.

relations.subject: Hermann Gundert
relations.evidence: Left immediately for India and started working for British Mission in Tinnevelly under Rhenius.

relations.subject: Hermann Gundert
relations.evidence: he moved in 1838 to Basler Mission in Malabar (North Kerala).

relations.subject: Hermann Gundert
relations.role: School Inspector for Malabar and Kanara
relations.evidence: became in 1857 Government’s School Inspector for Malabar and Kanara.

relations.subject: Hermann Gundert
relations.evidence: he headed Calwer Verlag from 1860 until his death.

relations.subject: Hermann Gundert
relations.evidence: another grandson was the Japanologist Wilhelm Gundert (1880–1971).
